lines.zh: 我蹦一下，火星就洒在草上。
lines.en: I hop once and sparks scatter across the grass.

lines.zh: 短腿迈得急，火苗一路歪。
lines.en: My short legs hurry and the flame leans the whole way.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚跟走，影子被自己照亮。
lines.en: I follow your heels, lighting my own shadow.

lines.zh: 走两步就喘，我的火也跟着抖。
lines.en: Two steps and I am winded; my fire trembles too.

lines.zh: 前面的路太黑，我先滚过去。
lines.en: The road ahead is too dark; I roll there first.

lines.zh: 蜡滴在地上，像给你留路标。
lines.en: Wax drips behind me like trail markers for you.

lines.zh: 我跑起来像一颗会跳的火星。
lines.en: At a run I am just a bouncing spark.

lines.zh: 我的光只够照到自己的脚。
lines.en: My light barely reaches my own feet.

lines.zh: 别等我，我腿短但会追。
lines.en: Do not wait; my legs are short but I keep chasing.

lines.zh: 走过湿草，我滋滋响了一声。
lines.en: Crossing wet grass, I hiss once.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，怕把自己弄灭。
lines.en: I walk gently, afraid of putting myself out.

lines.zh: 你走远三步，我的火就矮一截。
lines.en: Three steps from you and my flame sinks lower.

lines.zh: 我把自己插在土里歇一会儿。
lines.en: I plant myself in the soil and rest a while.

lines.zh: 火苗歪着头，等你回头看。
lines.en: My flame tilts, waiting for you to look back.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃饭，只要一点空气。
lines.en: I need no food, only a little air.

lines.zh: 蜡在慢慢变短，我知道的。
lines.en: The wax is growing shorter; I know it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我数自己的火星。
lines.en: In the quiet I count my own sparks.

lines.zh: 这点火很小，可我舍不得熄。
lines.en: This flame is small, but I will not let it die.

lines.zh: 我在等你把箱子打开。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to open the chest.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我就缩成一小团。
lines.en: When the wind blows I shrink into a small ball.

lines.zh: 炭在心里慢慢烧，声音很细。
lines.en: The coal burns slowly inside me, a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我站得久了，脚下积了一小圈蜡。
lines.en: Standing long, I leave a little ring of wax.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，我就烧得更旺。
lines.en: When you look down at me, I burn brighter.

lines.zh: 你的脸被我的火照成橘色。
lines.en: My fire turns your face orange.

lines.zh: 我在你眼睛里找自己的影子。
lines.en: I look for my own reflection in your eyes.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，火星会跳到睫毛上。
lines.en: Not too close; sparks may land on your lashes.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子发出蜡的响声。
lines.en: I look up and my neck creaks with wax.

lines.zh: 你看我一眼，我的火就直起来。
lines.en: One glance from you straightens my flame.

lines.zh: 你瞳孔里有两点小火，是我。
lines.en: Two small fires in your pupils; that is me.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，火苗开始打转。
lines.en: I recognize you, and my flame starts to spin.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我以为你要吹灭我。
lines.en: When you blink I think you mean to blow me out.

lines.zh: 我盯着你看，蜡一点点软下来。
lines.en: Staring at you, my wax softens bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我的火被拍歪了，蜡溅了一地。
lines.en: My flame is knocked crooked and wax splashes everywhere.

lines.zh: 疼倒不疼，就是暗了一下。
lines.en: It does not hurt; I simply go dim.

lines.zh: 你听见我滋滋响，那是我在忍。
lines.en: That hiss you hear is me enduring it.

lines.zh: 我身子裂了条缝，火从缝里漏。
lines.en: A crack opens in me and fire leaks out.

lines.zh: 别管我，先看那东西还在不在。
lines.en: Never mind me; check whether that thing is still there.

lines.zh: 我还亮着，说明还没事。
lines.en: I am still lit, which means I am still fine.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打得滚了两圈。
lines.en: That blow sends me rolling twice.

lines.zh: 我的光抖得厉害，你扶一下我。
lines.en: My light shakes badly; steady me a moment.

lines.zh: 蜡少了一截，火也矮了一截。
lines.en: A finger of wax gone, a finger of flame gone.

lines.zh: 我快灭了，可我还想照着你。
lines.en: I am nearly out, but I still want to light you.

lines.zh: 面包对我没用，我只吃空气和煤。
lines.en: Bread does nothing for me; I eat air and coal.

lines.zh: 你举着骨头，我却盯着你的火把。
lines.en: You hold out a bone, but I stare at your torch.

lines.zh: 我不馋食物，我馋你手里的打火石。
lines.en: I crave no food, only the flint in your hand.

lines.zh: 把它放下吧，我更想被放在地上。
lines.en: Put it down; I would rather be set on the ground.

lines.zh: 肉香飘过来，我的火苗毫无反应。
lines.en: Meat smell drifts by; my flame does not react.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我也只会烧掉那根棍子。
lines.en: Feed me and I will only burn the stick.

lines.zh: 我真正想要的，是离你近一点。
lines.en: What I truly want is to be a little closer.

lines.zh: 那块煤炭可以，别的都免了。
lines.en: That lump of coal, yes; everything else, no.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把让我心里发痒。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes my core itch.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只想贴在你口袋边。
lines.en: I eat nothing; I only want to sit by your pocket.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你会被烫一下眉毛。
lines.en: Bump into me and you will singe an eyebrow.

lines.zh: 我的身子很轻，一碰就滚开。
lines.en: I am light; one touch sends me rolling.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，蜡会黏在鞋底。
lines.en: Step on me and wax will stick to your sole.

lines.zh: 撞一下，火星飞进你的袖口。
lines.en: One bump and sparks fly into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我不疼，我只担心自己被撞歪。
lines.en: I feel no pain; I only worry about tipping over.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到我，火苗晃了三下。
lines.en: Your knee hits me and my flame sways three times.

lines.zh: 我太小了，你几乎把我踢飞。
lines.en: I am so small you nearly kick me away.

lines.zh: 碰一下就道歉，你比我还紧张。
lines.en: You apologize after one touch; you are more nervous than I.

lines.zh: 我贴住你的靴子取暖，别怪我。
lines.en: I press against your boot for warmth; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 撞散的火星落在地上还在烧。
lines.en: Scattered sparks still burn where they land.

lines.zh: 我们不会生小的，只会被做出来。
lines.en: We do not bear young; we are simply made.

lines.zh: 两支火把靠在一起，就算一家人。
lines.en: Two torches leaning together count as family.

lines.zh: 想要更多我，你得再去砍木头。
lines.en: Want more of me? Go cut more wood.

lines.zh: 我这一支没有伴侣，只有你。
lines.en: This torch has no mate, only you.

lines.zh: 火和火相碰，只会变得更亮。
lines.en: Fire meeting fire only makes things brighter.

lines.zh: 我的火不会传给另一支火把。
lines.en: My flame will not pass to another torch.

lines.zh: 别把我插在别人旁边，我会想你的。
lines.en: Do not plant me beside someone else; I would miss you.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有亲缘，只有同一根木棍。
lines.en: No kinship between us, only the same stick.

lines.zh: 若我熄了，下一支也不会记得你。
lines.en: If I go out, the next one will not remember you.

lines.zh: 排成一排的火把，彼此都不说话。
lines.en: A row of torches, none of them speaking.

lines.zh: 你可以把我捡起来，放进背包。
lines.en: You can pick me up and tuck me in your pack.

lines.zh: 别用空手抓我，蜡还是烫的。
lines.en: Do not grab me barehanded; the wax is still hot.

lines.zh: 被你拿在手里，我晃得很开心。
lines.en: Held in your hand, I wobble with joy.

lines.zh: 我捡不动东西，我没有手指。
lines.en: What could I grip? I have no fingers at all.

lines.zh: 那块煤炭滚过来，我用蜡黏住它。
lines.en: A coal rolls near and I stick it with wax.

lines.zh: 塞进背包前，先帮我掐一下火苗。
lines.en: Before packing me, pinch my flame a little.

lines.zh: 我抓住的只有你袖口的线头。
lines.en: All I catch is a loose thread on your cuff.

lines.zh: 轻点放，我的身子一磕就裂。
lines.en: Set me down gently; one knock and I crack.

lines.zh: 我在你口袋里闷得直冒烟。
lines.en: In your pocket I smoke from the stuffiness.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的火星，算我捡到了。
lines.en: The spark that fell is the one thing I picked up.

lines.zh: 那边的僵尸动了，我先烧它。
lines.en: That zombie moved; I will burn it first.

lines.zh: 我看到绿眼睛，就自己冲过去。
lines.en: I see green eyes and charge on my own.

lines.zh: 你不用下命令，火已经指着它。
lines.en: No order needed; my fire already points at it.

lines.zh: 有东西在黑暗里喘气，我听见了。
lines.en: Something breathes in the dark; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我认出了那身腐肉的味道。
lines.en: I recognize the smell of that rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 它朝你来，我的火苗立刻竖起来。
lines.en: It comes for you, and my flame stands upright.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那个摇摇晃晃的影子。
lines.en: I have chosen that swaying shadow.

lines.zh: 只要它敢靠近，我就跳上去。
lines.en: If it dares come near, I will leap onto it.

lines.zh: 骷髅的骨头在响，我数着步子。
lines.en: The skeleton's bones rattle; I count its steps.

lines.zh: 我的光太弱，可我知道它在哪。
lines.en: My light is weak, but I know where it is.

lines.zh: 那东西还没发现我，这正好。
lines.en: It has not noticed me yet; that suits me.

lines.zh: 我先亮一下，让它只看我。
lines.en: I flare once so it looks only at me.

lines.zh: 别拦我，它离你的床太近了。
lines.en: Do not stop me; it is too near your bed.

lines.zh: 我锁住它了，火苗追着它的脚。
lines.en: I have it locked; my flame chases its feet.

lines.zh: 它离你的床太近了，我先到
lines.en: It's too near your bed; I get there first.

lines.zh: 我绕到它侧面，火照着它的膝盖。
lines.en: I circle to its side and light its knees.

lines.zh: 它一挥手臂，我就矮下去躲。
lines.en: It swings an arm and I duck low.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，火苗几乎不晃。
lines.en: I creep along the ground, flame barely swaying.

lines.zh: 我数它的脚步，等它背对我。
lines.en: I count each footfall, waiting to see its back.

lines.zh: 它踩过的草是湿的，我记下了。
lines.en: The grass it stepped on is wet; I noted that.

lines.zh: 我在它影子里跟着，不发出光。
lines.en: I follow inside its shadow, giving no light.

lines.zh: 它转身太快，我滚到石头后面。
lines.en: It turns too fast; I roll behind a stone.

lines.zh: 我的火小，正好不容易被看见。
lines.en: My fire is small, which keeps me hidden.

lines.zh: 它伸手抓我，我顺着地面滑开。
lines.en: It grabs for me and I slide along the ground.

lines.zh: 我在等它靠近那堆干草。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to come near the dry hay.

lines.zh: 它每喘一下，我的火就低一点。
lines.en: Every breath it takes, my flame sinks lower.

lines.zh: 我离它只有两步，蜡开始滴。
lines.en: Two steps from it, my wax starts to drip.

lines.zh: 它闻到烟味了，我得再快些。
lines.en: It smells smoke; I must move faster.

lines.zh: 我把火藏在身后，像收起一把刀。
lines.en: I hide my fire behind me like a sheathed blade.

lines.zh: 我把它引到干草堆那边
lines.en: I draw it toward the haystack.

lines.zh: 它低头的时候，我靠近一寸
lines.en: When it looks down, I close an inch.

lines.zh: 风往我这边吹，烟遮住我
lines.en: The wind blows my way; smoke hides me.

lines.zh: 我熄了一小会儿，它就走开
lines.en: I dim for a moment, and it wanders off.

lines.zh: 我跳上它的腿，火顺着布烧。
lines.en: I leap onto its leg and fire climbs the cloth.

lines.zh: 一碰就燃，我不用挥爪子。
lines.en: One touch ignites; I need no claws.

lines.zh: 我把整团火按在它胸口。
lines.en: I press my whole flame against its chest.

lines.zh: 它拍打我，火星反而溅得更远。
lines.en: It swats me and sparks scatter farther.

lines.zh: 我的蜡黏在它手上，甩不掉。
lines.en: My wax sticks to its hand and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 烧起来了，它的叫声像漏风的箱子。
lines.en: It catches fire; its cry sounds like a leaking box.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也缺了半截。
lines.en: This blow costs me half my own length.

lines.zh: 我不躲，火要贴着才有效。
lines.en: I do not dodge; fire only works up close.

lines.zh: 它踩灭我一次，我又亮起来。
lines.en: It stamps me out once, and I light again.

lines.zh: 火苗钻进它的眼窝，它退了。
lines.en: Flame crawls into its eye socket and it backs off.

lines.zh: 我把最后一点蜡全烧在它身上。
lines.en: I burn my last bit of wax onto it.

lines.zh: 它抓破我的纸皮，火却更旺。
lines.en: It tears my paper skin, and my fire grows.

lines.zh: 你听见那声爆响了吗，是我干的。
lines.en: Did you hear that pop? That was me.

lines.zh: 我烧得很小，但它整条手臂都黑了。
lines.en: I burn small, yet its whole arm goes black.

lines.zh: 我蹭上它的裤脚，火往上爬
lines.en: I brush its trouser leg, and flame climbs.

lines.zh: 它一抓，我的火苗就粘上去
lines.en: It grabs, and my flame sticks to it.

lines.zh: 我从工作台上被拼出来，还带着木屑。
lines.en: I am assembled on a bench, still dusted with sawdust.

lines.zh: 第一次亮起来，我照到的是你的手。
lines.en: The first thing I light is your hand.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在地上，我就认了他。
lines.en: Someone set me down, and I chose them.

lines.zh: 我的火刚点上，蜡还是软的。
lines.en: My flame is new and my wax still soft.

lines.zh: 木头、煤、一点纸，我就这样活了。
lines.en: Wood, coal, a scrap of paper; that is how I live.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里冒出来，先照亮自己。
lines.en: I come out of the dark and light myself first.

lines.zh: 别把我插在潮湿的墙角，我会灭。
lines.en: Do not plant me in a damp corner; I will go out.

lines.zh: 刚落地我就想找个人跟着。
lines.en: The moment I land, I look for someone to follow.

lines.zh: 我身上的火比我想的更小。
lines.en: The fire I carry is smaller than I expected.

lines.zh: 一亮起来，附近的僵尸就转头了。
lines.en: As soon as I light, nearby zombies turn their heads.

lines.zh: 我还是热的，你可以先暖暖手。
lines.en: I am still warm; you may warm your hands.

lines.zh: 我被放在门边，负责守整夜。
lines.en: I am set by the door to keep watch all night.

lines.zh: 第一口气是烟，第二口才是光。
lines.en: My first breath is smoke; the second is light.

lines.zh: 我出现了，这间屋子就不算空。
lines.en: I appear, and this room is no longer empty.

lines.zh: 火对火没用，我反而更精神。
lines.en: Fire does nothing to fire; I only perk up.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我的火翻了个跟头。
lines.en: Dropped from a height, my flame tumbles over.

lines.zh: 水一淹，我就只剩一缕白烟。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I am only white smoke.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀飞，火却还黏在木棍上。
lines.en: The blast throws me, yet fire clings to the stick.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，蜡从洞里流出来。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and wax runs from the hole.

lines.zh: 那道光让我冷了一下，很奇怪。
lines.en: That light makes me cold for a moment, strangely.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，但没煤我也撑不住。
lines.en: I have no stomach, but without coal I fade.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的火被借走了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and borrows my fire for an instant.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我连烟都留不下。
lines.en: Falling into the void, I leave not even smoke.
